locations.title: Korek Charm
locations.description:
**Unlock:**
1. Jump from the [VNC Tower](#loc=157691) with your paraglider to the roof of this building near the [Military Airdrop THB-UT0](#loc=158146).
2. Grab the power cable from the power panel and drop off the building edge (facing east at the wooden plank that hangs slightly over the edge) and into the open window below.
3. Drop down once again into the open window below, then plug in cable at the red panel.
4. Repeat the last two steps to hook up two more power panels with the extension cords from above (grappling hook may be useful to lessen fall height).
5. After the third panel is connected, use your GRE key to unlock the security panel to the right and open the door.  Kill the suicider that is waiting for you.
6. Inside the room, sit in all four spots around the table.  After sitting in the final spot for about 20 seconds, the blueprint will suddenly spawn on the table.

locations.title: Doom Puzzle
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete story quest [Broadcast](#loc=160288)  

- Take the elevator to the basement in the [VNC Tower](#loc=157691).  Traverse lower until you come to another elevator and ride it down to the Doom Room.
- Find and place all 5 Black Ducks each on the tables that surround the center altar.  Duck locations:
  - [Black Duck](#loc=163255)
  - [Black Duck](#loc=163256)
  - [Black Duck](#loc=163257)
  - [Black Duck](#loc=163258)
  - [Black Duck](#loc=163259)
- Next, connect the wires to the panels behind the Black Ducks in such a way so that the wires create a large pentagram, similar to the one on the center altar.
- If done correctly, a gun will appear over the center altar, which offers the secret [Hangar Challenge](#loc=163260)

locations.title: Ka Doom Shotgun (PATCHED)
locations.description:
This was an exploit that let you carry the powerful shotgun used during the [Hangar Challenge](#loc=163260) in the outside world. **It has since been patched.**

**Unlock:**
1. Gain access to the [Hangar Challenge](#loc=163260) via completing the [Doom Puzzle](#loc=163263)
2. Be sure to get all collectibles/blueprints from the [Hangar Challenge](#loc=163260) first as _you will be completely locked out of the challenge after this exploit_.
3. Unequip all items from your main equipment slots before starting the challenge.
4. Begin the challenge and run around for about 30 seconds killing zombies before quitting the game to the main menu.
5. Upon loading back in, you should have the shotgun in your inventory!

locations.title: Bicycle (PATCHED)
locations.description:
An exploit in older versions of the game allowed you to use the the bicycle found in the [Bicycle Challenge](#loc=164278) It had the potential to break the challenge, and has since **been patched.**

**Unlock:**
1. First take all necessary steps to unlock the [Bicycle Challenge](#loc=164278).
2. Begin the challenge, ride the bike up the ramp just past the checkpoint, then steer off the ramp and fall to your death.
3. Upon respawn, go to where you fell to pick up the bike and use it to traverse the world as you please!

locations.title: Broomstick (PATCHED)
locations.description:
An exploit in older versions of the game allowed you to use the broomstick found in the [Baba Yaga Challenge](#loc=164974) to fly around the open world. It had the potential to break the challenge, and has since **been patched.**

**Unlock:**
1. First take all necessary steps to unlock the [Baba Yaga Challenge](#loc=164974).
2. Unequip all accessories from your inventory and begin the challenge.
3. After starting the challenge and flying on the broomstick, quit the game to the main menu.
4. Upon loading back in the game, you should start in the air - use the paraglider to get to safety and the broomstick should be in your inventory to fly around on as you see fit!

locations.title: Great Scott! (PATCHED)
locations.description:
An exploit in older versions of the game allowed you to use the the hoverboard found in the [Hoverboard Challenge](#loc=165014) to glide around the open world. It had the potential to break the challenge, **and has since been patched.**

**Unlock:**
1. First take all necessary steps to unlock the [Hoverboard Challenge](#loc=165014).
2. Unequip all accessories from your inventory and begin the challenge.
3. After starting the challenge and gliding on the hoverboard, quit the game to the main menu.
4. Upon loading back in the game, you should have the hoverboard in your inventory (an accessory called "Great Scott!") - use it to glide around the open world as you see fit!

locations.title: Safe 14-9-2
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Water Tower

If you chose to **help Jack and Joe instead of fight** them during the **Water Tower** campaign quest, you’ll be able to find them on the PK Floating Fortress. Now sitting in a jail cell, the duo gives you the **Moonshine side quest**. Before you head out, they tell you the safe code is “the year America was discovered.” 

They’re referring to when Christopher Columbus “discovered” America. That year would be 1492. And the **safe code is: 14-9-2**. 

Climb the Horseshoe Water Tower and pick the lock at the top.

locations.title: Baba Yaga
locations.description:
**Quest Giver:** Interact with the glowing mushrooms on the crane  
**Requirements:** 
1. To get to this location jump off the [VNC Tower](#loc=157691) and using your paraglider, aim for the boom of the yellow crane on the building below to the east.  
2. Drop down to the second square platform and interact with the glowing mushroom in the corner.  
3. Keep pressing and holding the interact button as necessary (the mushrooms will grow with each iteration) until interacting makes  the challenge appear (this takes a while).  

**Rewards:**
- Parkour XP

locations.title: Hoverboard Challenge
locations.description:
**Quest Giver:** Interact with the hoverboard inside the trunk of the blue car.
  
**Requirements:** 
1. Unlock this challenge by first restoring power to the [Church of Saint Thomas the Apostle](#loc=158075).
2. Climb up the bell tower to the top floor, then interact and listen to the radio on the table.
3. Pick up [Hoverboard #1](#loc=165009) when it spawns after listening to the radio - then use your survivor sense to follow the red footprints on the ground, out of the tower and down to the street.
4. Follow the footprints to, and pickup the 3 remaining hoverboards:
  - [Hoverboard #2](#loc=165021)
  - [Hoverboard #3](#loc=165011)
  - [Hoverboard #4](#loc=165012)
5. Close to a bus, find the blue car and open its trunk to reveal a final hoverboard.  Interacting with it will begin the challenge.  

**Rewards:**
- Parkour XP
